51270952.protein: Induced myeloid leukemia cell differentiation protein Mcl-1
51270952.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to TEV-fused His-tagged human Mcl-1 expressed in Escherichia coliBL21(DE3) pLysS cells by Isothermal Titration Calorimetry

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal Titration Calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Panalytical, Worcestershire, U.K.) at 25 °C. The protein (TEV-fused His-tagged human Mcl-1 expressed in Escherichia coli BL21(DE3) pLysS cells) was dialyzed against 20 mM HEPES (pH 7.4), 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, and 0.02% NaN3. The dialyzed protein was concentrated to 100 μM and loaded into the sample cell. The ligand (compound) was dissolved in DMSO and diluted in the same buffer to a final concentration of 1.5 mM and loaded into the syringe. The titration consisted of 20 injections of 2 μL each, with a 120 s spacing between injections. The stirring speed was set to 750 rpm. A blank experiment was performed by titrating the ligand into buffer alone. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (OriginLab, Northampton, MA) with a one-site binding model. The binding constants (Kd) were calculated from the fitted curves. The reported Kd values are the mean of at least two independent experiments.

assay_conditions.buffer_composition: 20 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, 0.02% NaN3
assay_conditions.control_method: Titration of ligand into buffer alone
